ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:20 ratio of high-intensity (white/scar) pixels to low-intensity (black/pigmentation) pixels across the visible ventral area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration profile; left lobe exhibits a major jagged indentation approximately 30% from the median notch; right lobe shows smaller, more rhythmic peaked variations.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white linear pixel disruptions; includes distinct intersecting 'X' marks on the left lobe and vertical rake marks across the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major traumatic notch/disruption on the medial trailing edge of the left lobe; dense acorn barnacle clusters present on the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent intersecting 'X' shaped scar on the mid-left lobe; several distinct circular ring-scars localized on the lower right lobe near the water line.
